# Brighter Day Press

> Christ-centered homeschool curriculum and seasonal guides designed for families seeking faith-integrated learning through living books, nature study, and morning time practices.

Brighter Day Press specializes in Charlotte Mason-inspired educational resources that combine biblical teaching with seasonal themes, nature study, and artistic activities. The company offers both digital and printed products including holiday guides, morning time curricula, and family devotionals curated by author Whitney Newby.

## Holiday & Seasonal Guides

- [The Thanksgiving Guide](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/the-thanksgiving-guide): 39-page faith-filled Thanksgiving unit study for families with interactive lessons
- [The Advent Guide](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/printed-advent-guide): Charlotte Mason-inspired 4-week Advent guide with readings and activities
- [The Easter Guide](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/easter-guide-printed-digital): Faith-based Easter curriculum teaching Jesus' sacrifice and resurrection story
- [Christmas Around the World Guide](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/christmas-around-the-world-guide): Four-week guide exploring Christmas traditions from Germany, Sweden, and beyond
- [The Valentine's Day Guide](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/the-valentines-day-guide): Biblical study of four loves for families exploring Valentine's Day origins
- [The Reformation Day Guide](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/the-reformation-day-guide): 30-page guide on Martin Luther and Protestant Reformation history for families

## Seasonal Learning Series

- [A Simple Spring](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/a-simple-spring-guide): 6-week spring study with living books and watercolor tutorials for families
- [A Simple Summer](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/asimplesummer): 8-week summer Morning Time guide with nature themes and family activities
- [A Simple Autumn](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/a-simple-autumn): 52-page autumn study for ages 3-7 with themed weekly plans and activities
- [A Simple Winter](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/a-simple-winter-guide): Winter study guide for early learners with 4 weeks of themed plans

## Morning Time & Core Curriculum

- [Morning Time Collection](https://brighterdaypress.com/collections/morning-time): Collection of Morning Time volumes with scripture cards and copywork books
- [The Nature Guide](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/the-nature-guide): Literature-based nature curriculum for ages 5-12 with hands-on activities
- [Creation Story Cards](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/creation-story-cards-printed): Hand-painted 5x7 devotional cards exploring seven days of creation with Scripture

## Nature Study & Art Classes

- [Nature Study Collection](https://brighterdaypress.com/collections/nature-guides): Nature guides, journals, and educational resources for outdoor learning
- [Watercolor Class: Spring](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/watercolor-class-6-nature-inspired-tutorials): Six spring-themed watercolor tutorials with video lessons for ages 5+

## Devotional & Inspirational Resources

- [Lift Your Eyes](https://brighterdaypress.com/products/lift-your-eyes): Devotional book by Whitney Newby encouraging Christian motherhood and faith
